risks.title: Economic risk and adverse conditions in the healthcare industry
risks.score_rationale: Adverse macroeconomic conditions (persistent inflation, elevated interest rates, geopolitical tensions) and federal regulatory changes (July 4, 2025 budget reconciliation law reducing Medicaid spending) directly impact budgets and purchasing decisions of healthcare organizations, HealthStream's primary clients.

risks.title: Dependence on healthcare sector clients
risks.score_rationale: HealthStream is heavily dependent on its clients (healthcare organizations) whose budgets and purchasing decisions are affected by economic conditions, regulatory changes, and increased reliance on government funding such as Medicaid.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and sensitive data management risk
risks.score_rationale: HealthStream processes sensitive health data and expands AI usage through hStream, increasing exposure to cybersecurity threats, data breaches and HIPAA compliance violations, with serious consequences for reputation and financial results.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risk
risks.score_rationale: HealthStream operates in a highly regulated environment (HIPAA, healthcare regulations, AI compliance) with anticipated changes to federal and state regulations impacting its clients and operations.

risks.title: Acquisition integration and management risk
risks.score_rationale: HealthStream completed two acquisitions in 2025 (Virsys12 in October for $11.4 million cash plus $4.0 million contingent consideration; MissionCare in December for $24.6 million cash, $4.0 million stock and up to $10.0 million contingent consideration), exposing the Company to technology integration, cultural and financial risks.

ai_positioning.summary: HealthStream addresses AI in a dual context: evaluating AI-related risks within its risk management, information security and data governance processes; but also positive AI capability integration through its hStream platform, which extends AI functionality to the applications it powers and serves as the system of record on which healthcare workforce AI relies.
